https://youtu.be/6w8E-5SwvoQ

videos.title: 570 - If you only chase CU savings you miss the point
videos.description:

#microsoftfabric #capacity #dataquality #datagovernance

videos.title: 570 - Files on your laptop through a personal gateway: unacceptable

#microsoftfabric #onelake #powerbi #datagovernance

videos.title: 570 - Why build your warehouse from scratch on some obscure tool?

#microsoftfabric #datawarehouse #dataarchitecture #consulting

videos.title: 570 - Shadow IT exists because you never gave them tools

#shadowit #excel #powerbi #datagovernance

https://youtu.be/6w8E-5SwvoQ

#microsoftfabric #cloudcost #dataengineering #semanticmodel

videos.title: 570 - Storage is cheap, compute is expensive. That flipped.
videos.description:

https://youtu.be/6w8E-5SwvoQ

#microsoftfabric #cloudarchitecture #dataengineering #capacity

videos.title: 570 - AIG called it unacceptable and it was a fireable offense

#microsoftfabric #datagovernance #powerbi #bestpractices

https://youtu.be/6w8E-5SwvoQ

#datacontracts #dataengineering #aiagents #microsoftfabric

Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
items.description: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365):  JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
items.description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

items.title: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
items.description:
OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page
items.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page. Updated October 23, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
items.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Speaker attribution now  “On” by default in BYOD rooms with enhanced admin controls
items.description: New PowerShell setting (SpeakerAttributionBYOD in csTeamsAIPolicy), enabled by default, gives IT admins more control over speaker attribution in BYOD (bring your own device) meeting rooms. This enhances the experience for users by enabling clear speaker labels and richer in-meeting and post-meeting insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Users just enroll profiles via Teams Settings to be recognized.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Decoupling of Policy tips and Email notifications while configuring rules on Data Loss Prevention for Sharepoint and Onedriv
items.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips
